name: bad_share_le
summary: With m = (1 - r/q)/q^r, every good tuple contributes at least m^f to the real part of the coefficient of e at 1 (labelChar_degree_bounds factorwise). Good tuples include all families in prod_w A_w that are not in prod_w B_w, where A_w are the monic polynomials of degree r with no root in {0} or mu_M and no square factor, and B_w the non-primitive ones. Counting: |A_w| m >= 1 - eps (at most (1 + M) q^(r-1) + r q^(r-1) excluded polynomials), and |B_w| m <= 1 - L/f (the minimal polynomials of the phi(q^r - 1) primitive roots give at least phi(q^r - 1)/r primitive labels, and n <= phi(n)(2 log n + 1)). Then Re e(1) >= (1 - eps)^f - (1 - L/f)^f >= 1 - f eps - exp(-L).

steps.claim: Rewrite the hypothesis on L as L <= f / (2r(2r log q + 1)) (the denominator is positive), and put m = (1 - r/q)/q^r.
steps.lean: rw [← le_div_iff₀' (by positivity)] at hL; let m : ℝ := (1 - r / q) / q ^ r

steps.claim: 1 < q, from 1 < r < q.
steps.lean: have h1 := hn.trans h2

steps.claim: 0 <= m (since r <= q) and 1 < q^r.
steps.lean: obtain ⟨_ : 0 ≤ m, _⟩ := by simp [field, h2.le], one_lt_pow hn.ne_bot h1

      filter_not, cast_card_sdiff (by simp), sub_mul]

    grw [(by lia : q ^ r ≤ (q ^ r - 1) * 2), cast_mul, le_totient_mul_log, ←
      (@hasEnoughRootsOfUnity (k w) _ _ ⟨by simp [Ne.pos, hn.ne_zero, ← hq
      w]⟩).1.choose_spec.card_primitiveRoots, sub_le] <;> simp [field, ← cast_mul, *]
    apply card_le_mul_card_image_of_maps_to (f := minpoly _) <;>
      simp_intro ξ g [monicsOfDegree, IsPrimitiveLabel, IsLabel, *]
    obtain ⟨⟨⟩, ⟨_, d⟩, i⟩ := hq w, (pow_pred_eq_one_iff ‹_›).1 g.1, (isAlgebraic _).isIntegral.1 ξ
    have := (g.2 _ (root_pow_card_pow_pred_eq_one (irreducible i) (by aesop) (by simp)).1).antisymm
      (pow_sub_one_dvd_pow_sub_one _
      ((root_pow_card_pow_eq_self_iff (irreducible i) (by simp)).1 d))
    simp_all [monic, irreducible]; use Nat.pow_right_injective h1 (by lia), ξ, by simp
    grw [card_le_degree_of_subset_roots (p := ξ.map (algebraMap ..)) fun _ ↦ _] <;> aesop
steps.typed_fact: #{c ∈ monicsOfDegree (k w) r | ¬IsPrimitiveLabel r c} • m ≤ 1 - L / f

steps.claim: Using L/f <= 1/(2r(2r log q + 1)), m <= 1/q^r and #(not primitive) = q^r - #(primitive), it suffices to show that the number of primitive labels of degree r is at least q^r/(2r(2r log q + 1)).
steps.lean:
grw [hL, div_right_comm, div_self_le_one, (by simp [field] : m ≤ 1 / ↑(q ^ r)), nsmul_eq_mul,
      filter_not, cast_card_sdiff (by simp), sub_mul]

steps.claim: Clearing denominators (monicsOfDegree(k_w, r) has q^r elements): it suffices that q^r <= 2r(2r log q + 1) #(primitive labels).
steps.lean: gcongr; simp_all [monicsOfDegree, ofEquiv_card, field]; field

steps.claim: Since q^r <= 2(q^r - 1) <= 2 phi(q^r - 1)(2 log(q^r - 1) + 1) <= 2 phi(q^r - 1)(2r log q + 1), and the algebraic closure of k_w contains exactly phi(q^r - 1) primitive roots of unity of order q^r - 1, it suffices that their number is at most r times the number of primitive labels.
steps.lean:
grw [(by lia : q ^ r ≤ (q ^ r - 1) * 2), cast_mul, le_totient_mul_log, ←

      w]⟩).1.choose_spec.card_primitiveRoots, sub_le] <;> simp [field, ← cast_mul, *]

steps.claim: Map each such primitive root xi to its minimal polynomial over k_w: it suffices that this polynomial is a monic polynomial of degree r that is a primitive label, and that each fibre has at most r elements.
steps.lean:
apply card_le_mul_card_image_of_maps_to (f := minpoly _) <;>
      simp_intro ξ g [monicsOfDegree, IsPrimitiveLabel, IsLabel, *]

steps.claim: For such a xi: |k_w| = q, xi^(q^r - 1) = 1, and xi is integral (algebraic) over k_w with an irreducible minimal polynomial.
steps.lean: obtain ⟨⟨⟩, ⟨_, d⟩, i⟩ := hq w, (pow_pred_eq_one_iff ‹_›).1 g.1, (isAlgebraic _).isIntegral.1 ξ

steps.claim: The degree of the minimal polynomial of xi is r: xi^(q^d - 1) = 1 for d its degree gives (q^r - 1) | (q^d - 1), and d | r gives (q^d - 1) | (q^r - 1); so q^d - 1 = q^r - 1.
steps.lean:
have := (g.2 _ (root_pow_card_pow_pred_eq_one (irreducible i) (by aesop) (by simp)).1).antisymm
      (pow_sub_one_dvd_pow_sub_one _
      ((root_pow_card_pow_eq_self_iff (irreducible i) (by simp)).1 d))

steps.claim: Hence d = r (q > 1), and the minimal polynomial is monic, irreducible, of degree r, with the root xi of order q^r - 1: a primitive label of degree r.
steps.lean: simp_all [monic, irreducible]; use Nat.pow_right_injective h1 (by lia), ξ, by simp

steps.claim: Each fibre consists of roots of one polynomial of degree r, so has at most r elements.
steps.lean: grw [card_le_degree_of_subset_roots (p := ξ.map (algebraMap ..)) fun _ ↦ _] <;> aesop

steps.claim: It suffices to prove the theorem from the inequality prod_w (1 - eps) <= prod_w #(A_w) m, where A_w is the set of monic polynomials of degree r over k_w that are neither (X - x) h with x = 0 or x^M = 1 and h monic of degree r - 1, nor g^2 h with g monic of degree (r - d)/2 and h monic of degree d < r; this inequality follows factor by factor (the factors 1 - eps being nonnegative) from the bound for each w.

    (monicsOfDegree _ (r - 1)) ∪ (range r).biUnion fun d ↦
    (monicsOfDegree _ ((r - d) / 2)).image₂ (· ^ 2 * ·) (monicsOfDegree _ d))) • m by
    grw [← hs, nsmul_eq_mul, ← sdiff_inter_self_left, cast_card_sdiff, inter_subset_right,
      card_union_le, card_image₂_le, card_insert_le, Multiset.toFinset_card_le, card_nthRoots,
      card_biUnion_le, card_image₂_le,
      sum_le_card_nsmul _ _ (q ^ (r - 1))] <;> simp [monicsOfDegree,
      ofEquiv_card, ← hq w, pow_sub₀, hn.le, field, ← pow_add, pow_le_pow_iff_right₀ one_lt_card]
    nlinarith; lia)

steps.claim: For every w: 1 - eps <= #(A_w) m.
steps.lean:
show 1 -
    ε ≤ #(monicsOfDegree _ r \ ((insert 0 (nthRoots M (1 : k w)).toFinset).image₂ ((X - C ·) · * ·)
    (monicsOfDegree _ (r - 1)) ∪ (range r).biUnion fun d ↦
    (monicsOfDegree _ ((r - d) / 2)).image₂ (· ^ 2 * ·) (monicsOfDegree _ d))) • m by
    grw [← hs, nsmul_eq_mul, ← sdiff_inter_self_left, cast_card_sdiff, inter_subset_right,

steps.claim: Counting: monicsOfDegree(k_w, r) has q^r elements; the excluded polynomials number at most (1 + M) q^(r-1) (at most 1 + M choices of x, q^(r-1) of h) plus sum_{d<r} q^((r-d)/2 + d) <= r q^(r-1); with (1 + M + 2r)/q <= eps the bound follows.
